descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 15 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
**The station lays itself out again every run. The machines are still there.**

# ☢️ Three decks

Reactor, Cryo Bay, Greenhouse. Up to 152 metres a side, 7 to 29 rooms.

# 🔫 Four guns in your hands

- **Pulse Pistol** - eighteen metres, twelve rounds
- **Heavy Revolver** - 45 a shot at twenty-three metres
- **Assault Rifle** - thirty rounds, two hands, automatic
- **Stutterer** - thirty-five rounds, shortest reach

A ring on the floor is your weapon's reach. Past its edge nothing lands.

[media]

# 🤖 Four machines, all shooting back

- **Trilobite** - fast, closes to ten metres
- **Eye Drone** - hovers at chest height
- **Quad Shell** - 160 health and plating
- **Servitor** - bursts from seventeen metres

Each winds up before firing, with a weak point worth 2.5 body shots.

[media]

# 💀 The Warden of the Deep

900 health, three phases, and it calls for help.

# 🛠️ 25 upgrade levels

Guns, tuning, plating, frame, medkits. Four artifacts drop from the dead: speed, damage, armour, repairs.

[media]

# ⚙️ Three difficulties, 17 comfort settings

Difficulty changes how many machines a deck holds, their health and damage, how far off they notice you, and what a kill pays. Hard fills every planned spot - up to 48 - and pays 60 per cent more.

Snap or smooth turning, vignette, seated play, dominant hand, haptics. The camera is never moved for you.
